nodes.bdb: Nahbi = "hidden" son of Vophsi, a Naphtalite, and one of the 12 spies sent to spy out the promised land

nodes.g: Vophsi = "rich" father of Nahbi, the man chosen as the spy for Naphtali
Gemalli = "camel driver" the father of Ammiel, the Danite spy
Susi = "my horse" father of Gaddi, the spy for the tribe of Manasseh
Sethur = "hidden" son of Michael, the spy from the tribe of Asher
Geuel = "majesty of God" the Gadite chosen to spy out the land, son of Machi
Gaddiel = "God is my fortune" the spy from the tribe of Zebulun sent by Moses to spy out…
Machi = "decrease" father of Geuel the Gadite who was one of the 12 spies of Israel
